body: A wound around trust and power, often from betrayal or loss of control; intimacy can feel dangerous.
business: You guide others through grief, crisis, and the things they cannot say aloud.
shadow: Controlling or testing others, or refusing to be vulnerable at all.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
